description: Task 1: query-to-item retrieval topics. known_item topics have one intended target (target_isbns lists every edition), so their relevance set is complete and Recall@5 is meaningful. Other categories are open-ended: relevance comes only from pooled graded judgments (judgments_queries.csv) and recall is not reported for them.
